# mao_agent

> High-performance vector database, Tantivy BM25 full-text engine, and dialectical cognitive reasoning engine for Chinese historical literature.

## Project Identity & Architecture
- Language: Rust 2024 Edition (Single crate, bin + lib)
- Capabilities: Dual-path hybrid retrieval (Dense embeddings + Tantivy BM25 RRF fusion), Materialist Dialectical 4-stage deduction, True-substring citation grounding verifier.
- CLI Entry: `src/main.rs`
- Library Entry: `src/lib.rs`

## Golden Rules for AI Agents
- Always use `--no-default-features` for all `cargo` invocations to guarantee fast, offline, deterministic execution without downloading the multi-hundred MB ONNX fastembed model.
- Never edit binary or index artifacts in `data/` directly; always regenerate via `cargo run --no-default-features -- ingest`.
- For offline operation or when no Cohere API key is configured, pass `--offline` to `ask` and `search`.

## Primary Agent Workflows
- Full-text & Semantic Search: `cargo run --no-default-features -- search "<query>" --top-k 5 --mode hybrid`
- Dialectical Q&A Consultation: `cargo run --no-default-features -- ask "<question>" [--offline]`
- Check Database & Index Status: `cargo run --no-default-features -- stats`
- Rebuild Ingestion Pipeline: `cargo run --no-default-features -- init-samples && cargo run --no-default-features -- ingest --corpus-dir corpus --batch-size 32`
